subject: Pre-brief: Nexus technical preview — procurement evidence gating
messages:
From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@nhx.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nhx.com
Date: 2028-07-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Nexus preview — can we lock in a technical walkthrough?

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the quick sync last week. The Nexus product team would like a technical preview focused on inference performance and deployment options (VPC/on-prem). Can we lock a 60-minute slot the week of Aug 7?

Procurement asked that we attach our standard vendor intake form up front — I’ve attached the questionnaire so you can see the gating items (security contacts, SOC reports, retention, subprocessing). If you need anything signed before the call, flag it.

Attach: nexus_vendor_questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Alex
Alex Jensen
Director, Platform Engineering — Nexus Health
alex.jensen@nhx.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@nhx.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-25T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexus preview — can we lock in a technical walkthrough?

Alex — thanks for sending the questionnaire. Quick read-through: procurement is asking for a completed vendor questionnaire, a signed NDA (they noted an exec-level NDA is required), and SSO/IdP provisioning details before a live, privileged demo that includes any PII examples. We will not be able to run the live demo with exec-level access until those gating items are closed.

To keep things moving, two options:
- Option A (preferred): We complete the questionnaire, sign the NDA via DocuSign, and provision a non-PII sandbox for the live session. Estimate: ~10 business days depending on procurement turnaround.
- Option B: We do an asynchronous recorded walkthrough covering architecture and public demo material this week so your team can evaluate while procurement completes intake.

Marcus, can you prepare a 10–12 minute recorded technical preview (architecture + perf numbers + hosted vs. private deployment) that we can send to Nexus if they opt for Option B? Priya, tagging you for any red flags in the questionnaire (especially data retention and subprocessors).

I’ve attached our vendor intake checklist and a link to the NDA DocuSign to speed procurement.

Attach: redwood_vendor_intake_checklist.xlsx, redwood_nda_docusign_link.txt

--
Priyom Das
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

From: Nexus Health Procurement <procurement@nhx.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@nhx.com>
Date: 2028-07-25T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexus preview — can we lock in a technical walkthrough?

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the options. Procurement has a hard requirement to have the vendor questionnaire fully completed and the NDA executed before any sessions that involve privileged environment details. Given our current legal queue and the internal travel schedule, it is unlikely the gating will be cleared before Aug 7.

We’d prefer Option B (asynchronous) for the initial pass so engineering can start evaluating. Once procurement confirms the completed questionnaire and signed NDA, we’ll coordinate a live session with the appropriate SSO access window — likely mid- to late-August.

Can your team provide the recorded preview by EOD Wednesday (7/27)? Also please include a short checklist that maps the questionnaire items to where Redwood has the evidence (SOC2 link, retention policy, subprocessors list). That mapping will speed our review.

Thanks,
Nexus Procurement Team

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@nhx.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-26T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Nexus preview — can we lock in a technical walkthrough?

Alex / Priyom — noted. I’ll record a 12-minute technical preview (slides + short live demo against a scrubbed dataset) and include a one-page mapping document that points to our SOC2 report, retention policy, and subprocessors. I’ll upload the package to a share link and ping procurement when it’s ready.

Tentative plan: record today and send by 7/27 EOD; once Nexus confirms the questionnaire is complete and NDA is signed we’ll propose live demo windows the week of Aug 21.

If procurement can provide their preferred DocuSign signing contact, we’ll nudge legal for faster turnaround.

--
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
